title: The Physics of Life (ft. It's Okay to be Smart & PBS Eons!)
summary: PBS Space Time, together with It's Okay to be Smart and PBS Eons, asks how a universe drifting toward disorder produced something as complex as life. It presents the idea that the laws of physics, through thermodynamics, may actually favor the emergence of life.
why: HN commenters point to it as an accessible pop-science introduction to entropy and the physics of life, including Jeremy England's work.
topic: entropy and the origin of life

quote.text: it's a very good video on this topic by PBS
